items.summary: Kenyan President William Ruto has faced a social media backlash after publicly suggesting that Nigerian-accented English was incomprehensible and required a translator.
items.summary_zh: 肯尼亚总统威廉·鲁托(William Ruto)在公开表示尼日利亚语的英语不可理解并需要翻译后,遭到社交媒体的反弹.

items.title: South Korea police arrest man for posting AI photo of runaway wolf
items.title_zh: 南韩警方逮捕男子,
items.summary: South Korean police have arrested a man for sharing an AI-generated image that misled authorities who were searching for a wolf that had broken out of a zoo in Daejeon city.
items.summary_zh: 韩国警方逮捕了一名分享AI生成的图像的人,
